records.suspicion: SuppressPointsStacking (EA 7) is admitted on consumers that ignore point stacking

records.suspicion: CSA-D-05: a raw-39 school-immunity holder taking covered caster-delivered (self) raw-165 damage diverges from Trinity, which would zero it.
records.why_rejected: Trinity applies school immunity only to negative effects: Unit::IsImmunedToSpell skips an immunity entry unless NegativeEffects & effectMask or the immunity aura has SPELL_ATTR1_IMMUNITY_TO_HOSTILE_AND_FRIENDLY_EFFECTS (Unit.cpp:7797-7800), and Unit::IsImmunedToDamage(caster, spellInfo) skips it for spellInfo->IsPositive() under the same attribute test (Unit.cpp:7890-7891); Spell.cpp:2912 (damage-time check) and Object.cpp:1957 (SpellHitResult) both route through these. A raw-165 DAMAGE_FROM_MAX_HEALTH_PCT effect is not in the negative-effect switch of _isPositiveEffectImpl (SpellInfo.cpp:4747-4767), targets TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (positive target) and therefore returns positive (SpellInfo.cpp:5062); no TDB/SpellMgr override exists for 1257873. The only admitted provider 161901 has no attributes. So Trinity also lands the damage: Core matches the consumer. Every raw-165 (1,0) row that passes Core owner-attribute gates lacks ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF (raw 26, uncataloged) and IsHarmful effect attributes (census, scratch/R1). Core's own catalog row names the slice "admitted positive neutral self-targeted". Residual: only the catalog wording "assumes absent immunity" (spell_effect.rs:262) is stale, info.

records.suspicion: CSA-C-01 scope: every beneficial / buff / resource impact is critical-eligible (evidence "every beneficial impact regardless of has_damage").
records.why_rejected: In prepare_impact_quotes "beneficial" means has_healing (planning.rs:808); a critical is prepared only for periodic-health, healing, Target-recipient, or damage impacts (planning.rs:850-935). A Caster-recipient aura-only self buff never resolves Critical: probe r1_real_rows.rs::holds_real_player_self_buff_impact_never_resolves_critical (real 156021 under Player crit 1.0 -> Hit). The finding survives only for Target-recipient impacts without amounts (defect_exact_stun_crits_from_enemy_weapon_channel_with_zero_spell_chance).

records.suspicion: CSA-J-05 two-source witness: 60 s with +50/+60 gives Core 24999 where Trinity gives 25000.
records.why_rejected: Trinity forms the recovery-rate product first and multiplies once: recoveryRate *= 100/(amount+100) per aura, then int64(cooldown * recoveryRate) (SpellHistory.cpp:432-455). 60000 * (100/150 * 100/160) = 24999.999999999996 -> 24999, equal to Core. Only the single-source 16.5 s / +10 witness diverges (Core 14999, Trinity 15000), and R3 found no real raw-286/raw-148 amount x SpellCooldowns value that diverges. Supports R3 (REJ-R3-002): LATENT, info.

records.suspicion: CSA-K-01 Set-mode clause: a real raw-289 Set-mode row executes with a wrong stack count because Core can only Add/Remove.
records.why_rejected: Of 21 base-difficulty raw-289 Set-mode rows, one passes the owner-attribute audit: Golden Hubris 1213197 (Set 7 on 1213195, (1,0)). Its target aura 1213195 has CumulativeAura 7, so the best host declaration AddAuraStacks{count: 7} yields min(current+7, 7) = 7 from any state, identical to Trinity SetStackAmount(7) (SpellEffects.cpp:6126-6146). No real Set-mode row is observably wrong for a faithful host; the identity/direction clauses need a host declaration that contradicts its own source row (validation fail-open).

records.why_rejected: probe r3_reset_coverage.rs::holds_reset_fingerprints_on_uncovered_fixtures (PASS): 24 more public fixtures x {plain, stochastic defense/crit input}, casts Player->enemy, Player->Player and enemy->Player, 14 rounds, 2,999 committed casts: quote purity, failure purity, reset == fresh, reset replay identical, reset_for_iteration == fresh for the new identity and identical replay. records.suspicion: CSA-J-05 source witness: raw-286 +50/+60 on a 60 s cooldown gives Core 24999 vs consumer 25000 (also 15 s and 30 s)
records.why_rejected: The consumer forms the complete rate product before touching the cooldown (SpellHistory.cpp:443-450 recoveryRate *= ...; :452-455 int64(cooldown.count() * recoveryRate)), so 60000 * (2/3 * 5/8 in double = 0.41666666666666663) = 24999.999999999996 -> 24999, identical to Core; J's replica 60000*(100/150)*(100/160) multiplies the base first. 15 s -> 6249 and 30 s -> 12499 also agree. Divergences for (+50,+60) exist only at 1.5/3/6/12/21/24 s etc., and the only 12.1.0 raw-286 carriers with those amounts are Ancient Ankh Talisman 287777 (+50) and Trueshot 288613 (+60), which never modify one action together. Every single source raw-286 amount and every same-category pair of raw-148 amounts shows 0 witnesses over all SpellCooldowns/SpellCategory durations (scan in scratch/R3). CSA-J-05's mechanism stays real for synthetic amounts (J's +10% witness) -> downgrade to info LATENT.

records.suspicion: CooldownState::reset rebuilds charges from the current (possibly runtime-modified) maximum rather than the construction maximum

records.suspicion: H's Debug-based fingerprint could hide divergence through custom Debug impls or masked scratch subtrees that carry semantic state
records.why_rejected: The only custom Debug impl in combat/sim state is VersatilityAuthority (versatility.rs:413-421), which prints every field; RandomStream derives Debug (random.rs:7) and prints root_seed, global_iteration and full state; masked subtrees are *Workspace/*scratch/quoted_costs, which every entry re-prepares (RNG-I-012), and the unmasked diff is limited to absorb workspace residue in both H's and R3's fixtures.

records.suspicion: Fixed-travel arrival drops a packet silently (no observation) when the target's liveness changed after the launch draw was committed
records.why_rejected: Mirrors the consumer: Spell::TargetInfo::DoTargetSpellHit returns when unit->IsAlive() != IsAlive (Spell.cpp:2811) for delayed hits; the launch draw is committed in both.

records.suspicion: Iteration reset could mix identities (e.g. RandomStream::reset after reset_for_iteration replays the old identity, or Engine derives a chunk-local iteration)
records.why_rejected: RandomStream stores root_seed/global_iteration and reset() re-derives from them (random.rs:79-85); reset_for_iteration replaces the whole stream with identity.stream() (state.rs:447-451); Engine forwards the host identity unchanged (engine/src/lib.rs:856-859) and owns no other RNG or rotation state (RotationState is pure scratch, rotation/src/execution.rs:304-309).

records.suspicion: raw-38 preview ignores delivery suppression, so preview and commit could consume different draws

records.suspicion: ExactMechanicResistance tables assert dodge/parry are +0.0; a dodge-capable defender could panic resolve_with_adjustments
records.why_rejected: with_resisted_mechanic asserts Magic defense (attack/resolution.rs:164-174) and dodge/parry eligibility require DefenseType::Melee (:226-241), so both are the literal 0.0.

records.suspicion: CSA-I-02 shares its flaw with other captured/deferred paths (dispel preview assert, mechanic-dispel forced trials, deferred activations, split-leech preview)
records.why_rejected: PreparedImpactQuote::captured is constructed only for fixed-travel arrival (planning.rs:815-825); deferred activations re-quote children fresh without captured outcomes (commit.rs:957-993); the raw-38 and split-leech previews replay the same stream position (REJ-I-006) and the mechanic-dispel trials are fixed at 100% (occurs_forced ONE always true). Only the fixed-travel carrier freezes a table outcome across a quote boundary.

records.suspicion: White main hand keeps swinging from a dead source (G cross-track note) contradicts REJ-F-011
records.why_rejected: Both hold: runtime never re-checks source life, but admission requires a living source (white_swing.rs:341-343) and isolation admits exactly one Player->Enemy hostile relation with actionless or Dark-Bite-only programs (white_swing.rs:265-280, program/white_idle.rs:40-120), so no admitted program can lower Player health. Class E masking, no finding.

records.suspicion: CSA-C-02 protection claim: sole-effect op-15 providers are admitted only through the named Martial/Heart branches
records.why_rejected: Disproved: composition_is_admitted_by returns true for arity 1 and generic_spell_modifier routes raw-108 op 15 to CriticalBonus; the production candidate admits exact Awestruck rows (x_op15_real_rows.rs). What actually protects real data is the payload owner attribute audit, not the provider admission.
